root_cause: A memory leak occurred in the RAG retrieval server because the embedding transformer model was instantiated inside the query helper function rather than as a global singleton. On heavy traffic, concurrent requests caused multiple instances of the transformer to load into memory, exhausting host RAM and triggering OS SIGKILL (exit code 137).
fix_applied: Refactored `src/detection/relevance_scorer.py` to load the `BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5` SentenceTransformer model exactly once at module startup, converting it to a singleton. Added garbage collection hooks after heavy retrieval executions.
outcome: Resolved. Memory usage stabilized at a flat 1.2GB without showing linear growth trends under concurrent load testing.
